payload.core_mechanism_summary: Compute longest path in DAG from smaller to larger nodes using DP with 1D state (depth array), then multiply by node degree to get max beauty.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP on nodes in increasing index order, updating depth[v] = max(depth[v], depth[u]+1) for edges u<v, which is classic dp_1d_state. Not a 2D state, tree DP, or other subtype.
